items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: I don’t know whether Berry Gordy was there with the Tops and their manager come in and see that there’s this little chick out there.

ctx.x: An instrumental chart, you wrote the chart, and then you write the vocal parts and then you have them come in and you sing them the parts or whatever it takes to make this happen.

Yes. We did the tracks first. We were, by then, in at least four track I believe, and so it could — we could do the tracks and they came in from Detroit, the Tops did, and they called and said, “Do you want our arranger to do it” and they said, “No, we have our own arranger” and that was me. So you can imagine when I don’t know whether Berry Gordy was there with the Tops and their manager come in and see that there’s this little chick out there. And so I did the Tops and whatchacallit Martha, Jackie DeShannon,…
Wow. What a story. Were you one of the few women in that level of the business at the time?
